preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 1 <= n <= 100000 for n in [int(line) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and not any(c.isdigit() for c in line.split()[0] if line.split()[0].isdigit()])]
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is an integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in s) and 1 <= len(s) <= 8 for s in all_strings)
preconditions.description: Every string s_i consists of lowercase English letters and has length between 1 and 8 inclusive.
The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line) == n and all(c in '01' for c in line) for line, n in zip(output_lines, test_case_n_values))
postconditions.description: Each output line is a binary string of length n corresponding to the number of strings in that test case.

postconditions.expression: all(output_lines[i][j] == '1' if any(s[i] == s[k] + s[l] for k in range(n) for l in range(n)) else '0' for i, n in enumerate(test_case_n_values) for j in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each string s_i in a test case, the j-th bit is '1' if and only if there exist indices k and l (where k and l can be equal) such that s_i equals the concatenation of s_k and s_l; otherwise it is '0'.
